name: My Classmate Is A Sex Demon!
source:
Former porn star Han Yuxuan tries to start a new life by going to community college, but gets frequent (wet) dreams that hampers his sleep and academic performance. It may be the doings of a incubus, but that's just ridiculous...

[From [url=https://heian.itch.io/mcsd]itch.io[/url]]
